feedback: Some poster silhouette and brown-costume cues are retained, but this is not a close scene-ready likeness.
Red-tinted round glasses are present in the source; red tint itself is not the defect. Thin frames/lenses/eyes/nose boundaries are lost and the lower face merges into a broad black mask.
Hair and profile collapse into cap/wedge forms; rear texture is nearly black.
Walking/rifle statue is the wrong scene pose; no seated Japanese reader or handoff can be verified.
No skin or animation is present; a material change alone cannot correct texture, geometry or scene-role failures.
Some side-of-head/beard/shirt detail improved, but face still has pale patches and blurred glasses/brow/cheek/nose separation. Red lenses are intentional; geometry and boundaries remain weak.
Profile beard remains a long dark flat-ended form with pale ear/sideburn streaks. Rear costume is nearly black and has inconsistent leg patches.
Red debris near feet resembles reconstructed promotional footer/logo. Walking/rifle pose is wrong for seated reader; no in-truck or handoff view exists.
Independent reviewer finds a substantially clearer head than both full-body poster attempts, useful as a component candidate but not accepted yet.
Glasses are warped/asymmetric/drooping; lip/nose-mouth proportions differ and lips appear inflated/pink; ear coloration is red. Rear texture remains black and original material remains dark.
Black press-shirt/microphone bust is not the correct film-reader body. No full-body rig, seated/book pose, or in-game handoff exists.
No positive identity/component or complete-scene release approval was granted. Cleanup, correct-film styling and fresh independent review are still required.
